posts.title: Four Doors
posts.caption:
Doom scrolling isn't random. You walk through one of four doors, every time:
Bored: the work goes flat
Stuck: you hit something you can't do
Anxious: you remember how behind you are
Tired: it's late and you're fading
Stuck? The step is too big, not beyond you. Come back with the next line, not the whole problem.
Save this for the next time your hand goes for the phone. Send it to the friend who's always "so behind."
Comment LOCK and I'll DM you the 4-question quiz. One of the questions will be uncomfortable.
#doomscrolling #discipline #lockin

posts.title: Phone Exile
posts.caption:
Studying with your phone face down isn't discipline. It's still one reach away.
There are four places your phone can be while you work:
In your hand. Face down. Across the desk. Another room.
Only the last one works. Face-down is not distance. Walking is.
Save this and check it before your next study session. Send it to the friend who "locks in" with their phone face down.
Comment LOCK and I'll DM you the 4-question quiz. It shows what's actually pulling you to your phone.

Next time it hits, say it out loud: "that is minute two."
Save this for your next study session. Send it to the friend who quits in the first five minutes.
